description: A single 200-unit exact-input swap on pool B collects a 1-unit hook fee (1% of gross output, rounded down). Creator intent R1 credits floor(1/2) = 0 rebate, and the active patched contract agrees, but the draft base specification imposes a minimum_rebate of 1 and predicts 1 earned unit. This falsifies the specification's rounding rule against the current baseline (revision 1, cumulative-claim patch active) without any contract violation, isolating the remaining spec defect.
